decisions.reason: Across low/median/high actual powers, the EPD3 diagnostic keeps the distance peak at 0 D while broadening DOF50 from about 1.19-1.21 D to 1.29-1.33 D; standard-eye residual low-order readback and all ray-health checks pass, with no discrete diffraction-order behavior introduced.

Across low/median/high actual powers, the EPD3 diagnostic keeps the distance peak at 0 D and broadens DOF50 to about 2.44-2.46 D; standard-eye residual low-order readback and all ray-health checks pass. The source actual-eye piston failure is an aperture-limited SSAG Mode-0 readback artifact, not a residual or mechanism failure.

Across low/median/high actual powers, the EDOF whole-eye wavefront preserves the intended opposite-sign spherical-aberration pattern (C4<0, C6>0), broadens DOF50 to about 2.03-2.07 D, and shows a consistent -0.5 D peak shift; standard-eye residual low-order readback and all ray-health checks pass.

notes: These are mechanism-surrogate decisions, not claims of commercial-IOL replication.
No residual seed, amplitude, SA target, piston/defocus tolerance, or new numerical threshold was changed during review.
